usage: cox chair freeze-lands [-h] [--for MINUTES] [--reason TEXT] [--off] [--profile PROFILE]

With --for and --reason, freeze lands until the minutes pass.
With --off, lift the freeze.
With neither, show whether lands are frozen.
A freeze that outlives its minutes lifts itself.

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --for MINUTES      minutes the freeze lasts; needs --reason
  --reason TEXT      why lands are frozen; needs --for
  --off              lift the freeze now; not with --for or --reason
  --profile PROFILE  the routing profile (default: ~/.config/agent-tools/profile.yaml or
                     $AGENT_TOOLS_PROFILE)
